name: Blurred Lines
source:
They say that men and women can't be "just friends." For six long years, you've proven them wrong— until you make a proposition your best friend can’t refuse.

[From [url=https://chapters-interactive-stories.fandom.com/wiki/Blurred_Lines]Chapters - Interactive Stories Wiki[/url]]
